description: 한국철도기술연구원 연구사업정보 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도기술연구원. 한국철도기술연구원 연구사업정보는 기관이 수행하고 있는 다양한 국가·민간 연구개발 사업에 대한 주요 내용을 종합적으로 정리한 자료로, 각 연구사업의 전반적인 추진 현황과 기본 정보를. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도기술연구원. Its tags are 연구사업, 철도, 교통, 철도차량, 전력신호. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-03-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
